**Regionshospitalet Horsens** is a hospital located in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], Denmark. It is actively monitored as part of the national clinical quality development program for acute high-risk abdominal surgery, with its performance tracked in the annual Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) reports published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP).

During the reporting period from September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023, the hospital's compliance with [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] (administration of antibiotics within three hours) was recorded at 32.3% [^src1]. In the same period, the hospital met the standard for [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]], achieving a 66.7% rate for the placement of an epidural during surgery [^src2]. The hospital's clinical outcomes are also stratified by patient comorbidity. For patients with a [[charlson-score-1-2|Charlson Score = 1 or 2]] (indicating mild to moderate comorbidity), the 30-day mortality rate following acute surgery was 18.8%, representing 6 deaths out of 32 patients [^src4]. 

In the subsequent reporting period from September 1, 2023, to August 31, 2024, Regionshospitalet Horsens continued to be evaluated on mortality indicators stratified by comorbidity. The hospital recorded 6 deaths within 30 days after acute surgery among 25 included patients with a Charlson Score of 1 or 2, a metric associated with [[indikator-9b|Indikator 9b]] [^src9]. Additionally, for patients with severe comorbidity (Charlson Score ≥ 3), the hospital also recorded 6 deaths within 30 days among 25 included patients, tracked under [[indikator-9c|Indikator 9c]] [^src9]. The hospital's data is further utilized in broader demographic analyses, such as the age and gender distribution of operated patients and the prevalence of cancer diagnoses among the surgical cohort [^src5] [^src10].
